The main claim is a continuous-time ODE asymptotic-stability statement involving limits, trajectories, and attractor semantics. Z3 can encode algebraic sign conditions or finite approximations, but faithfully encoding the actual limit/attractor theorem would require real analysis and trajectory semantics not available in the requested z3-solver setup. Checking only the derivative sign or Lyapunov algebra identity would be an easier side calculation, not the main asymptotic claim.
